objections.claim: E6 remains an unresolved authorization and enforcement defect. The approach simultaneously requires mandatory bwrap/seccomp-based pure execution and deterministic exhaustive qualification, then states that reliably isolating arbitrary Node oracles is out of scope and leaves the actual ABI/harness choice to an Argo spike pending Eye ratification (`product-1-oq-e6-determinism-deferral`; `2026-08-28-e6-oracle-determinism.json`). Same-input repeated evaluation detects only observed variance; it cannot prevent a stable-within-qualification clock/entropy-dependent oracle from producing a different gate-time verdict. Therefore the plan does not yet provide a settled fail-closed mechanism or satisfiable acceptance oracle for E6. The Eye must rule the deferral and the approach must either select a concrete enforceable execution ABI or narrow/remove the unsupported determinism claims before convergence.
